**What type of PR is this?**

/kind feature

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Phase 2 B queue-side portion of AS-I21/AS-I37. A fresh queue writer can enlist both per-kind admissions in its original SQLite transaction. On a confirmed original-input replay the Store can read back each exact reference and frozen binding from the original blocker/message/kind, including after enqueue committed but its acknowledgement was lost. A missing preparation is unidentified before capacity, reader selection or Manager admission. This removes the previous attempt to submit the quick reference for both kinds. Existing queue/admission table layouts stay intact.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #2464, #2113, #2199, #2210, #2426, #2443. The production work package stays open. [Owner coordination, writer inventory and unlock conditions](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7097035105). [Accepted ordering and identity](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7093817861).

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

- Fork head `fee2b2e761b88877ca89aa80217be720fa9393ca`; target `component/agent-service` at `3b60c57ee2a622c3534e9ac84150a0945480a9c3`. Initial component SHA `268cf074c64d593e7102eb19616b6dcea3133eeb`. Initial main `7743b6857ed8d6f17a76571db64705ef8c27c37e`; refreshed main `9ccc5327a4a6f6ac9a9fa147b9a7c5f7454e6605`. No open PR code used.
- macOS, Python 3.12.13. Focused pytest on session_manager/test_side_runs, test_as_side_runs, test_as_backend_side_terminals, test_as_st_t10_beebou_quick, test_as_main_side_runs, test_sqlite_question_cards and test_store_publications: **145 passed, 94 subtests**. Beebou package **413 passed, 241 subtests**. The clean original main Bridge/SQLite scenario ran **7/7**; real CLI Gateway and Harness with controlled model and weather providers. Initial Beebou pytest setup lacked pytest-asyncio; the listed pass includes all 28 async cases after installing it. The legacy run initially lacked keyring; the 7 passes use the legacy service dependencies. On the newer main 9ccc5327a, the identical 7 scenarios all timed out. The old model caller still calls ModelGatewayProxy.post_json removed by #2281, reproduced as AttributeError before provider I/O. [Exact baselines and caller](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7097372191).
- The reference/recovery tests exercise real SQLite connections, writer lock barriers in both quick/normal orders, SessionSideRuns, SQLiteSideRunStore, Backend.start_side_run and Backend final coordination. Stand-ins provide the queue input row, authorization/window, B1 Host ports, M1 effects/consumption and obligation rows, Harness supervisor and Gateway. The T10 path launches the real Beebou child with a controlled model/Gateways and a stand-in Manager. Neither suite proves a complete production-owner transaction. Full Agent Service unittest discovery on the head: **2,732 tests, OK (2 skips, 4 expected failures)**. All 28 executable changed production lines covered. Architecture: 456 files checked, zero findings. The final commit adds the editable design and test trace IDs. Verified static dependency wheel: 122 members; both changed Side Run modules matched candidate source bytes. Used the clean target as the trusted manifest root. Tracked tree: 241,907,621 bytes (250 MiB gate).
- The additional trusted Beebou enrollment probe has four failures in isolated source-copy fixtures that omit plugins/beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou. The combined package/A02/enrollment run had 91 passes, 1391 subtests and those four failures. A clean export of target 3b60c57ee reproduces the same 4 failures (3 passes). No gate/fixture altered.

- Cold replay on the merged DMS1 profile: the real SQLite publication owner and Backend startup scanner process an empty journal, a canonical completed-terminal row, and the next fresh open. The Gateway received the stored answer once at durable sequence 1; Store marked the sequence and the third scan delivered zero events. M1 journal input, catalog/authorization and Gateway are controlled. A separate two-Run probe confirmed a new SQLite first-run opener returns UNKNOWN on both already-entered claims; only the seeded quick row was published, and the secondary journal remained empty. The probe's first non-canonical JSON fixture was blocked; supplying the canonical Store encoding passed. No unified-production M1 or queue activation is claimed.

- Integration against the actual #2474 merge `c8ca87f0d2fee56f7dd494a6541a8284a6d5c918`: clean preview tree `f7a92eb5bf2de05ec7b69d1c9389595fbd0ddb1b`; QOWNER + side tests **148 passed / 94 subtests**, whole Agent Service pytest **2,760 passed / 2 skipped / 4 xfailed / 2,324 subtests passed**, architecture **458 files, 0 findings**. The first export ran under the macOS /tmp path alias, causing three subtest comparisons and one test of Harness source ordering to fail. With the same export at its canonical physical path, the 19 Harness tests / 7 subtests passed. One full run then observed a child exit code of None before reaping; the exact crash test and a full repeat passed without changing source or assertions. #2474 contains queue contract probes plus an unaccepted existing-session operation proposal. [Store handoff and current interface decision request](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7098300777).

**Activation and outstanding acceptance**

Delivery/Manager must enlist the pair on the original queued-input write, retain the original sealed input, blocker claim, generation, watermark and selection, and notify Backend only after confirmed commit. Missing references stay unidentified. The merged question profile includes durable first-run/B1/Stop facts and a journal reader. Its execution Delivery profile explicitly rejects an existing-session target and requires fresh Sessions; the production queue needs the existing Session. There is still no common checked schema for that authority, both side tables and the canonical Workspace turn. The [Store owner handoff](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7097377183) confirms that matching a CanonicalHostedClaim to RunClaim requires a trusted same-transaction issuer. Store/Workspace must provide caller-transaction authorization, original/window, claim_start and original M1 verification/application with the actual revision. Then the formal opener can inject SessionSideRuns into OwnerModules.side_runs and run both production paths through startup scan with the same Store. Defaults remain off. No deployment or shared device tested.

**Self-checklist**:

- [x] Store/Manager accepted the scoped v1 design and queue/recovery interfaces at the exact fork head. [Recorded verdict](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2464#issuecomment-7098520034).
- [x] Regression tests cover transaction rollback/visibility, lost enqueue ACK, read-only recovery, scoped identity, both writer orders, missing preparation and both Backend terminal ports.
- [x] Real participants, substitutes, unverified production paths and activation conditions listed.
- [x] Existing published Manager/Backend signatures and stored schema preserved. Internal queue helper and per-kind missing-reference rule documented.
- [x] No official website change.

本 PR 是 HarmonyOS 客户端重构进入 `main` 的唯一代码合入入口。后续工作项直接追加提交到 Jun-Eric 的 `codex/harmony-client-refactor-2408`。#2409 继续用于 Gateway 与客户端讨论契约。汇总分支已保留其提交历史；当前 HM-C1 正文、字段字典、程序类型、覆盖表、样例与检查程序均已和 #2409 的 `162af776a` 对照。双方确认契约变更后，在本 PR 列出受影响方法、调用方和各 owner 的修改。

候选 `7bb38c6557d7e852f07609cf960ded664ead2bd2` 基于 main `dd24a9f8e`，本地合入树为 `7b7e6839ef3e11e8889ab4e7c33e23800e925b3d`。本轮按已登记的 13 只读和 23 延期口径交付。#2409 的八份契约与检查材料已逐文件对齐。

2479.body:
## 解决的问题

- Hive 延迟初始化时，报告控制器没有绑定 Beebou 事件入口，确认报告后仍可能走旧的 Host 制稿链路。
- 同一活动的后续邮件只修改受众时，服务端会用本轮提取结果覆盖原有事实，导致日期和时长在变更卡上显示为「未提供」。
- Bee 偶尔在聊天会话目录生成 PPTX，而 `deliver_file` 从任务工作区读取文件，导致成品已经生成，首次交付却报找不到文件。
- 手机 PPTX 预览会跳过部分标准箭头和水滴形状，导致页面元素缺失并显示兼容性警告。

## 改动链路和文件

- **Hive 初始化 → 报告派单**  
  `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py`  
  在 Hive 延迟初始化完成后，补绑报告控制器、Beebou 事件入口和聊天操作回调。

- **变更邮件 → 报告事实 → 变更卡与改稿**  
  `temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/service.py`  
  按字段合并通过校验的邮件事实。后续邮件省略的字段沿用上一轮值，并保留原邮件来源。

- **用户确认 → Bee 制稿 → 附件交付**  
  `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/report_runtime.py`  
  在报告任务指令中明确使用 Host Bash 的任务工作区生成和校验 PPTX，并把同一个相对路径传给 `deliver_file`。工具层的工作区约束未调整。

- **PPTX 解析 → 手机预览**  
  `tools/artifact-preview/src/vendor/pptxPresentationParser.ts`  
  `tools/artifact-preview/src/vendor/PresentationPreview.tsx`  
  支持上、下、左、右四种标准箭头和水滴形状，按形状调整参数绘制。同步更新 `digitalmate/entry/src/main/resources/rawfile/artifact-preview/` 下随手机包发布的预览资源。

- **预览回归测试**  
  `tools/artifact-preview/tests/pptx-placeholder.test.mjs`  
  覆盖五种新增形状及其调整参数，并修正 Windows 下的测试工作目录解析。

## 验证结果

- **首稿交付**：test-0 新邀约经手机确认后由 Beebou 派单，第一次调用 `deliver_file` 即成功，首稿已登记。
- **变更邮件**：第二封邮件只修改受众，正确关联到原报告。变更卡只列出受众变化，原日期和 25 分钟时长保留，后台事实仍引用首封邮件。
- **改稿交付**：确认变更后，小学生版关联到首稿产物，第一次调用 `deliver_file` 即成功。首稿和改稿均已登记，本轮两次交付均未复现路径错误。
- **手机预览**：修复包已在真机确认显示正常。10 项自动测试通过，另用 4 份实际 PPTX 共 35 页进行了逐页解析回归。

2484.author: aitianshi
2484.body:
Closes #2483

## What

An operator can give one isolated Hive Home instance's Bees its own stdio MCP servers:

- `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_HOME_MCP_SERVERS` names an operator-owned JSON file (mode 0600, outside the agent workspace): `{"cwd": "/abs/dir", "servers": [{"name", "command", "args", "env"}]}`.
- `dm_hive_tools.session_mcp.SessionMcp` validates it, starts the servers once before Hive accepts turns, and closes them with the Bee runtime. MCP children get the SDK's safe default environment plus their explicit `env`, never the Host's provider environment.
- Two Bee-only, Host-listed catalog tools, `list_mcp_tools` and `call_mcp_tool`, executed through the existing Host effect gate and effect receipts. Beebou delegates; it never sees tools it cannot call.
- Without the setting nothing changes: the two tools are not offered.

Design notes: `temp/hive-tools/SESSION_MCP.md`.

## Files

- `temp/hive-tools`: `session_mcp.py`, `handlers/session_mcp.py`, catalog rows, ownership, tests.
- `server_engine/server.py`: build from the setting, one startup step, close with the Bee runtime.
- `server_engine/hive_bee_runtime.py`: register the tools with the Bee's plugin tools.
- `test_hive_bee_tools.py`: the rail policy has no MCP tools without configuration.

## Tests

Refs #2113. Decision AS-I34 in `agent-service-implementation-decisions.md`; contract page `docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-approval-effect-ports-v3.1.md`.

## What this adds

HostAPI now records what an approved tool call did and tells the user exactly what they are approving.

- **Effect records.** Every asked tool call gets an effect record with a class, an optional inverse action and a settlement (`applied`, `not_applied`, `indeterminate`). The ports are `EffectRecordPorts` (Session Store) and `MandateStatePorts` (Session Manager), defined in `backend/host_api/effects.py` with stand-ins under `tests/server/agent_service/standins/`.
- **Approval cards.** A card shows every value whole. It hides exactly three things, each with the counted marker `[redacted N characters]`: a text value under a credential-named JSON key, URL userinfo, and a URL query value whose whole name is in `redacted_parameter_names`. There is no free-text scanning. A call whose card would exceed `max_card_chars` or `max_command_chars` is refused instead of shortened.
- **Action describers.** `backend/host_api/action_describers.py` ports the shell, configure and device-setting describers behind `ToolActionDescriber`.
- **Suspension.** A tool call made while the Run is suspended on an indeterminate effect answers non-retryable `BAD_INPUT` with `effect: none`.
- **Settings.** New keys in `agent_service.toml`; seven retired keys still load with a warning.

Everything stays behind `enabled = false`. The deployed entry is unchanged.

## What other owners must implement

- **Session Store:** `EffectRecordPorts`, including settle to `INDETERMINATE`, one further settlement after `INDETERMINATE`, and `open_approval` for a `read_only` record with no plan row.
- **Session Manager:** `MandateStatePorts`.
- **Plugin Gateway:** `ToolEffectProvider` and `ToolActionDescriber` for its tools.

## Known limit

A secret written inside a command or a request body is shown on the card and stored with it. Only the three cases above are hidden.

## Scope notes

- New files: `effects.py`, `action_describers.py`, the contract page, one stand-in and seven test files.
- `module-ownership.json`: public names added for the two new modules, `approvals.py` and one settings constant. No owner grant changed.

Refs #2113. Decision AS-I39 in `agent-service-implementation-decisions.md`; contract page `docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-backend-instance-end-v3.1.md`. This implements decision 1 of the Store alignment on #2113 on the Backend side.

## What this adds

When a server dies, the next server now knows which Runs the dead server's Harness processes held, and reports that to Session Manager until it is recorded.

- **Held entry before H1.** The launch record (version 3, additive `held` field) names the Run and its claim reference durably before H1 is sent. There is one H1 send site and it sits behind the hold.
- **End file.** The sweep writes `<sweeper>.<process>.end.json` before it removes a dead server's record, with the proof it has (`process_dead`, `server_restart`, `host_reboot` or `unverified`).
- **Reporter.** `backend/instance_end.py` calls `record_instance_end(InstanceEndRequest) -> InstanceEndObservation` (`OwnerModules.instance_ends`) with the key `instance-end:<dead server instance id>:<process id>`, and repeats an unknown answer every `recovery.terminal_reconcile_seconds`. Start order: relay, publish, offer instance ends, then `owners.recover`.
- **`names_run(run) -> bool | None`** for Session Manager's recovery of a Run that was entered and never held.
- **Settings.** `[supervisor] held_reference_max_chars`, `[recovery] instance_end_call_seconds`, `[recovery] instance_end_start_seconds`.

Everything stays behind `enabled = false`. The deployed entry is unchanged.

## Ruling carried by this change

Decision 1 on #2113 stands. An instance end with proof completes a Stop that was earlier recorded `stop_unconfirmed`; one of kind `unverified` does not. Backend still submits `CANCELLED` with code `stop_unconfirmed`; Session Manager must answer `ManagerUnknown` for it, not refuse.

## What Session Manager must implement

The full list is the section "What Session Manager must implement" of AS-I39. No implementation exists yet; the stand-in is `tests/server/agent_service/standins/instance_end.py`.

## Scope notes

- New files: `backend/instance_end.py`, the contract page, one stand-in and five test files.
- `module-ownership.json`: a new component row `agent-service-backend-instance-end` (owner: Agent Service execution owner), public names for it and for `launch_records.py` and `ports.py`, and **one grant**: `owner_modules.py` may import `agent-service-contracts`, for `AdmittedRunIdentity` in the `names_run` signature.
- No Session Store, Session Manager or Delivery module is changed. `plugins/workswarm_bee` is not touched.

## Left for a follow-up

`settle`, `_note_runs` and `_drop_record` still take the held-entry lock on the event loop, so a slow disk flush can hold the loop for tens of milliseconds. A B1 with a newer claim for a Run that already started keeps the old claim in its entry (behaviour unchanged from before).

## Tests

Gates ran on `8435eb001`. The head `17ffd3d57` only adds the merge of component head `3cef31b30` and has the identical tree.

2493.author: Jianyu010
2493.body:
Refs #2491, #2113. Decision AS-I41 in `agent-service-implementation-decisions.md`. The `read_run_events` row of `server-agent-service-mobile-gateway-proxy-v3.1.md` now names its implementer.

## What this adds

Backend's conversion that Delivery needs for AS-C2 `MobileASProxy.read_run_events`, the read-back of missed durable events after a disconnect. The Session Store and Delivery owner asked for it on #2113.

- `FinalCoordinator.events_from_publications(*, identity, publications) -> tuple[RunEvent, ...]`, named for Delivery by the Protocol `RunEventCodec` in `backend/final.py`. The assembly hands Delivery the same instance that publishes the Run's events.
- It decodes exactly as `publish_unpublished` does (`_payload`, `_KINDS`) and checks each row with `egress.check_event`, the AS-C3 check. Store's `durable_sequence`, the full Run identity and the terminal answer pass through unchanged.
- The whole batch is checked first. A row of another Run, a non-durable kind, an undecodable payload or an AS-C3 violation raises `PublicationDecodeFailed(ValueError)` for the batch and takes no `sequence`; Delivery maps it to `UNAVAILABLE`. The message names the row's `durable_sequence` and kind, never its payload.
- It never publishes, marks or holds, and settles no obligation.
- `sequence`: a Run that is held, or already has a counter in this process, continues that counter, so a read-back event never repeats a live delta's number. An ended or unknown Run is numbered from 1 and leaves no state.

## For the Session Store and Delivery owner

- Delivery keeps authorization (`NOT_FOUND`), the Run check, `read_publications` and continuity/pagination; it calls this method last.
- A terminal row Store writes on its `content_version` 0 path (`{"outcome": "<kind>", "candidate": ...}`) has no revision or answer, so read-back fails on it with "no terminal content". Backend always submits version 1, so the open question is whether that Store path stays, or whether such rows are migrated.

## Tests

Head `afa04dd61`, which contains component head `e772b4524` (#2492).

- New `tests/server/agent_service/test_as_backend_run_event_codec.py`: 10 tests, 8 subtests.
- Agent Service plus Beebou plugin on the merged head: 3537 passed, 4 failed. The 4 failures are in `test_as_command_harness.py::ShippedTableTest` and fail identically on the unchanged component head `3cef31b30` (base run: 3004 passed, the same 4 failed). Nothing new fails.

- `module-ownership.json`: the two new public names were added to the `final.py` entry. No owner grant changed.

An independent review found no correctness bugs. Its three findings are addressed in `22a6d9501`: the content-less terminal row now has its own message, the docstring states when sequence numbers may repeat, and tests now cover a Run resent by the startup scan and a side Run.

Everything stays behind `enabled = false`; the deployed entry is unchanged.

2495.body:
Implements #2489 under #2113 / #2110. Target is `component/agent-service`. Verified head `d1b752a46590618a9c3bb14b9661fc1d7fae374c` includes component base `3aa71c21ec68d7308a4f84c37bfefff60998baee`.

### Design and ownership

[Design and signatures, v1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/d1b752a46590618a9c3bb14b9661fc1d7fae374c/docs/implementations/contracts/hive-bot-layer-v1.md) · [Editable architecture deck](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/d1b752a46590618a9c3bb14b9661fc1d7fae374c/docs/assets/feature-design/hive-bot-layer-review-v1.pptx) · [Reviewed version and component-owner merge decision](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2489#issuecomment-7101483828).

HB-D1–D6 supply the Bot provider and roster, SQLite definitions/templates, generation-scoped resident WorkSwarm processes, report replay to the original Bee/Beebou sessions, Mobile report projection, and the Hive input to AgentService.prepare. Dispatch only advertises supported options. Named Delivery identities survive retry. The timeout distinguishes expiry before and after effect entry. Host rail and per-Bee process group own the selected effects. The two external runtime wheels are pinned and verified. The migration ledger records remaining legacy callers.

#2496 and #2494 provide the canonical Delivery classes. Installed and staged tests assert object identity through both import paths. Generic lifecycle and the AS-I22 opener interface landed in #2462. Relative to the component base, Hive changes no source in Session Store, Session Manager, Delivery or server_runtime.

### Component verification

| Case on the head above | Result |
| --- | --- |
| HB-T1 and HB-T2 | A Home message returned Beebou's reply. A second case used the live roster, accepted dispatch(new), delivered the original text to a registered native WorkSwarm Bee, and relayed its DONE report through Beebou. The test checks original task, Bee session and Run, one report and final user reply. |
| HB-T3 with four real counterpart implementations | 2/2 passed in 7.415 s. Paired Plugin Gateway #2357 at `6395a792e`, Delivery sender #2399 at `488821116`, Mobile Gateway #2463 at `e38f6d509` and isolated pinned external WorkSwarm. Real ClientMobileProxy.on_frame served message.list and activity.list, sent state.changed and replayed the AgentPeer terminal journal. |
| Legacy isolation | Staged source physically omits top-level harness/ and temp/. A deliberately importable retired module was rejected. The runner requires import-guard evidence from the Host interpreter and each registered command Harness. Native WorkSwarm uses an isolated external interpreter. The default two-case run also passed. |
| Agent Service, Bot and Server Runtime | 3,282 passed, 2 skipped, 4 expected failures and 2,839 subtests passed. The skips require Linux directory descriptors and the retired Bridge adapter respectively. The 4 expected failures are existing Store/Manager conformance cases. |
| Build and architecture | 152 package/context tests and 2,023 subtests passed. Actual root wheel verified all 186 members. Architecture check reported 0 findings across 533 checked files. The hosted repo-size check passed. |
| Independent review | A separate reviewer approved the exact component head, reran 26 focused cases / 32 subtests, and independently passed both Home tests with native WorkSwarm and physically absent legacy roots. |

Reproduce the staged run with the component Python and these separate owner checkouts:

```sh
python tests/server/agent_service/verify_hive_legacy_absent.py \
  --plugin-gateway "$PLUGIN_GATEWAY_CHECKOUT/server/plugin_gateway" \
  --delivery "$DELIVERY_CHECKOUT/server/agent_service/delivery" \
  --mobile-gateway "$MOBILE_GATEWAY_CHECKOUT/server/mobile_gateway" \
  --native-python "$NATIVE_WORKSWARM_PYTHON"
```

The repository-wide proxy scan is advisory (72 findings at head and 69 at base). The standalone raw-policy SQL domain scanner stops on an existing uninventoried Bridge chat_context.py. Earlier rounds exposed a missing child import path and the revised Mobile session credential requirement, both fixed. A restart-identity timing test failed once in an intermediate suite and passed in isolation and the complete final run.

### Substitutes and receiving owners

- The model is deterministic, including responses to native WorkSwarm's real HTTP model relay. The test provides the authenticated subject and owner authorization, a frame collector in place of the phone/network, a controlled clock and the feature-enable settings.
- Assembly supplies Store/Manager test owners for admission, generation/claim and slot reservation, task/Run state, serialization, terminal CAS with its report obligation, durable wakeup/recovery, publication and receipt facts, and optional question/checkpoint reads. BotRepository, roster projection, plugins and subprocesses are real. Readiness and turn facts use fixture sources, and the optional routing observer is absent.
- Mobile's message projection, notification and replay use the real Gateway and SQLite. Its scoped activity reader supplies committed test rows to the real report mapper; production activity pagination and account/device enrollment remain with Mobile. Default mode substitutes Gateway bindings, a Mobile event port and a scripted WorkSwarm adapter. The fully paired mode above replaces those participants.
- Dev B owns production Store/Manager admission, terminal/report transaction, wakeup and sender reconciliation (#2399 / #2401). Runtime/Boot owns product composition with live owner openers and activation (#2116). Component verification did not exercise a deployed stack, a production LLM or a physical phone.

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Pre-register the Delivery-owned canonical message and identity modules and their existing consumer dependency edges before #2494 adds the source. Both new paths are `pendingSource`; no source, runtime behavior, storage, or new authority is added here. This lets the next source change be checked against a separately reviewable component policy rather than its own modified inventory.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #2113, #2401, #2494. No issue is closed.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results (Function, performance, reliability, etc.)**:

Base `f6510225a`, head `88ea09a29307b8b515839a82d21f91663d0b65c0`; Windows Python 3.12 manifest validation passed (180 owners, zero exceptions), component source scan against this proposed policy had zero findings, and `git diff --check` passed. A local simulation using this policy to scan the #2494 working tree after syncing `f6510225a` also had zero findings. This does not establish hosted CI or main's trusted policy, and no source/runtime or e2e test is claimed by this policy-only PR.

**Self-checklist**:

+ - [ ] **Design**: Owner and public dependency registrations are available for review.
+ - [ ] **Test**: Policy checks are reported; no runtime UT/ST applies to this isolated registration.
+ - [x] **Verification**: Base/head, scans and limitations are stated.
+ - [ ] **Interface**: Canonical source and Gateway version pairing are in #2494 / #2463 and not claimed complete.
+ - [ ] **Document**: No official website documentation change.

2498.author: Jianyu010
2498.body:
## Problem

`eval.yml` starts on every pull request to `main` that touches `tests/eval/**`. On a pull request from a fork, `actions/checkout` refuses to check out the head under `pull_request_target`, so `Eval contract (replay)` goes red without running anything (for example run 45175809277). The nightly schedule only produces skipped runs.

## Change

- `.github/workflows/eval.yml`: remove the `pull_request_target` and `schedule` triggers; keep `workflow_dispatch`. This is what `docs/guides/testing/v31-ci-merge-gates.md` already lists for this workflow. Both jobs and `tests/eval` stay.
- `tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs`: assert that `eval.yml` is manual only instead of asserting its pull request trigger.
- `docs/guides/testing/ci.md` and `UPDATES.md`: say so.

## Tests

`node --test tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs`: 20 passed.

## Note

The workflow file on `main` still runs for this pull request, because `pull_request_target` reads the base branch. The trigger stops once this is merged.

2499.author: Jianyu010
2499.body:
Promotes the two reviewed Agent Service component merges since #2497. #2462 supplies opt-in service lifecycle and #2495 supplies Hive. Component source is fixed at c2584e4ca. The main merge resolution preserves the existing Boot factory, Model Gateway, Mobile Gateway and independent Mobile wheel. The feature stays behind the existing configuration.

Refs #2489, #2460, #2110, #2113, #2116 and #737.

Lane: F
Issue: #2489   RFC: #2113   ADR: n/a — promotion of the reviewed component implementation
Design: docs/assets/feature-design/hive-bot-layer-review-v1.pptx
Spec: docs/implementations/contracts/hive-bot-layer-v1.md
Design review: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2489#issuecomment-7101483828
IDs implemented: HB-D1, HB-D2, HB-D3, HB-D4, HB-D5, HB-D6, HB-T1, HB-T2, HB-T3
Tests: HB-T1 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_as_st_hive_home.py::test_home_reply, HB-T2 -> tests/server/agent_service/test_as_st_hive_home.py::test_home_dispatch_reaches_bee_and_report_reaches_home, HB-T3 -> tests/server/agent_service/verify_hive_legacy_absent.py
Source: main 05be8673c / head bede262d6; server.server_runtime.runtime.serve, AgentService.prepare and assemble_hive
Ownership: Runtime owns startup. Hive owns the Bot provider and resident process lifecycle. Delivery owns the wire types. Store/Manager own admission and durable terminal/report obligations.
Placement: server/agent_service, server/hive_assembly.py, plugins/bot, plugins/beebou, plugins/workswarm_bee; ownership.json updated: yes
Transition: the supported paths and remaining legacy readers are recorded in the Agent Service migration ledger. #2113 owns cleanup after production consumers move.
Verification: PASS for both clean-tree Home cases on the promotion merge, using native external WorkSwarm, #2357 at 6395a792e, #2399 at 488821116 and main's Mobile Gateway from e9612f75e. The model, Store/Manager, authenticated Home identity, activity reader and phone transport use fixtures. Deployed system and device NOT_RUN.
Self-review: DEV-01..DEV-15 checked; the final gate reads the main inventory merged by #2504.

### Main integration evidence

- Agent Service, Bot and Runtime tests passed 3,283 cases and 2,839 subtests, with 2 skips and 4 existing expected failures. The skips concern Linux directory descriptors on macOS and the retired Bridge. The expected failures concern Store/Manager contracts.
- At 0ec14b787, the combined Beebou and Mobile tests passed 468 cases and 331 subtests with the async pytest plugin and JSON Schema test dependency installed. The initial test environments lacked these dependencies. The direct Mobile / Agent Service interoperability runner passed all 13 cases.
- The six package and context suites on an immutable export of 0ec14b787 passed 157 tests and 2,054 subtests. The 188-member root wheel and standalone Mobile wheel have disjoint member sets; all 15 Mobile source/data members match source. The paired startup keeps main's Boot FactoryInput, Model Gateway binding selection, startup cancellation and shutdown ordering.
- Independent review compared both parents and all eight conflict resolutions. It reran 42 focused tests and 28 subtests, plus both physical legacy-absence native Home cases. The final packaging files were also verified from the immutable head.
- On the initial base, the hosted Architecture job failed its trusted snapshot self-test before it tested the PR. On that preceding main baseline the legal control reports 12 unregistered Mobile modules. Main's inventory also lacks the new Hive identities/packaging entries. A proposed policy in this source PR cannot authorize these entries in the trusted gate. [Architecture job](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/45178421949/job/137706216493)

[Component merge and acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2489#issuecomment-7101585468)

### Final main candidate

#2503 repaired the existing Mobile ownership record. #2504 pre-enrolled the Hive owners and package controls. The final product diff activates exactly 42 pre-registered Python files. It preserves the protected owner declarations, the Mobile row and both package formats. The selector in this product PR is identical to the one already on main. The approved one-time Mobile repair exception for #2501 went unused; #2501 closed as a duplicate.

The code tree of final head 0cb6d32ec is identical to efd7bbc79. The final native, paired, clean-tree Home run passed both cases in 10.847 s. The real trusted scanner from the #2504 base checked 547 of 789 files with zero findings. Size and the relevant main checks are recorded on the [final GitHub run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/45181880763). The feature remains disabled in the shipped default configuration. Full-stack, device and live-model integration are deferred to follow-up testing.

The preceding 0cb6d32ec hosted Architecture and Runtime jobs both passed. Main then added #2506 before merge. Final head bede262d6 preserves its RunEventCodec alongside Hive GenerationProcesses. All 66 affected tests and 20 subtests passed, plus 2/2 clean-tree paired native Home tests in 7.654 s. The final run is [here](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/45182783321).
